question: Who won the 2025 Booker Prize, and for which book?
text: **David Szalay** won the 2025 Booker Prize for his novel *Flesh*. ([thebookerprizes.com](https://thebookerprizes.com/the-booker-library/prize-years/2025?utm_source=openai))
